summary: Round track idler wheel, 54 mm in diameter, with a 14 mm central bore. The face shows a recessed inner hub area and a raised outer rim. Lightening slots, smaller holes and screw bosses are visible on the face, but their sizes and positions are not given.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front face with the recessed hub area and outer rim, centered on the bore
Opposite face, with the outer cylindrical rim as the track-contact surface

notes: The 54 mm diameter and 14 mm bore come from the listed specs, which are marked unverified. The 9 mm thickness is a rough estimate from the product photos, since no thickness is printed or listed. The z axis is the wheel axis. The smaller holes, slots, and bolt-circle bosses are visible, but no dimensions are given, so they are left out of the hole list. The inner hub step depth is also unknown.
